description: This file defines the FormSubmitter class in Drupal, responsible for processing form submissions, executing handlers, managing redirects, and batch processing.

classes.name: FormSubmitter
classes.description: Handles form submission processing, including executing submit handlers, managing redirects, and batch processing within Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the FormSubmitter with dependencies, with a fallback to a service call if $callableResolver is not provided.

methods.name: doSubmitForm
methods.description: Processes the form submission, executes handlers, manages batch processing, and handles redirection responses.

methods.name: executeSubmitHandlers
methods.description: Executes the submit handlers for the form, either from form state or form array.

methods.name: redirectForm
methods.description: Generates a redirect response based on form state, handling URL-based and route-based redirects.

methods.name: batchGet
methods.description: Wraps the batch_get() function to retrieve batch information.
